hypothesis: At least one externally motivated stress-resolution indicator can identify frozen V11 de-risk events that are too early, improving net CAGR by at least 0.50 percentage points while matching or exceeding V11 Sharpe and preserving <=10% full-history MDD under the same Swift engine and execution assumptions.
allowed_changes: F-BAA exact BAA10Y falling-over-20-source-observations state with strict prior-date availability
F-EPU exact USEPUINDXD falling-over-20-source-observations state with strict prior-date availability
event-only retention of exactly 50% of each frozen V11 de-risk reduction when factor risk-on
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Report every candidate against frozen V11 and its own matched availability control, then run the same fixed bootstrap, family CSCV/PBO and family/global DSR audits for all three candidates.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: full CAGR >= V11 CAGR +0.50 percentage points
deterministic: full Sharpe > own matched availability control Sharpe
deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260821
family DSR probability >=95% using all three candidates
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using HR-A/B/C, all 18 prior formal factor candidates, and all three candidates in this trial
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, PBO and both DSR gates
follow_up_policy: This is the only retrospective family in the literature-stress-factor-v1 campaign. After any formal result is viewed, do not replace candidates, search alternative lookbacks/thresholds/sources/retention fractions, combine factors, alter the event definition, or open a second retrospective family under this campaign. A promising non-robust candidate may only enter a new prospective trial from a new freeze date.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_literature_stress_factor_v1.py -> tools/literature_stress_factor_v1.swiftpart + tools/literature_stress_factor_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
source/de-risk/available/retained event counts and portfolio constraints
mechanical deterministic ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS flags for all three
paired block-bootstrap statistics for all three
family DSR and cumulative post-protocol DSR for all three
mechanical ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS flags for all three
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

F-BAA.availability_rule: latest finite observation with observation_date < signal_date and <=7 calendar days stale

F-EPU.availability_rule: latest finite observation with observation_date < signal_date and <=7 calendar days stale

F-MOVE.availability_rule: latest finite close with observation_date <= signal_date and <=7 calendar days stale

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any threshold, percentile, z-score, persistence or stale-tolerance search
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or fourth candidate after results
changing fee/slippage, leverage, financing, shorting or cash constraints
using T+0 FRED observations or future observations
dropping failed post-protocol candidates from DSR accounting
